CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (RFS) was met with HR 0.75 (p=0.0013), showing clear clinical benefit. Secondary endpoints DMFS and OS also showed significant improvement. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: High toxicity rates led to 52.4% discontinuation vs 9.1% placebo, but efficacy was still demonstrated despite this. The trial was adequately powered and conducted properly.
